snippet.title: How Many Dudes? - Game Trailer - Convergence Showcase
snippet.description: A dude-builder roguelike where you recruit an army of dudes to fight ridiculous battles. How many dudes does it take to beat up a gorilla? A thousand toddlers? A horse-sized duck? A GOD? Enter your Dude Ranch and find out. https//store.steampowered.com/app/3934270/How_Many_Dudes/
